_comment: Ratchet, not exemption (#83). Hosted CI fails when tests/e2e grows MORE type errors than this number; shrinking is allowed and should be followed by lowering the number in the same PR. 77 was measured 2026-10-23 on the re-anchor branch; TIGHTENED to 67 the same day — see below: 39 wrong-arity, 10 argument-type, 9 overload, 6 possibly-undefined, 4 phantom-property, plus a few one-offs. TIGHTENED 2026-10-24: 77 → 67. One annotation bug (`actionGraceMs = 20_000 | false`, a BITWISE OR, not a union) accounted for ten of them, and `TapeEntry.file` was never declared though `loadTape` stamps it. That is the ratchet doing its job: the notice said to lower it, so it was lowered in the same change rather than left as decoration. This exists because `rotated is not defined` — a real, corpus-destroying bug in tests/e2e/session.ts — was invisible to every existing gate: tsc excludes the directory and Playwright does not type-check.
